name: bmad-sprint-planning
description: Prioritize and sequence a bounded batch of RAG project work. Use when asked to plan a sprint, milestone, or implementation batch.
---

# Sprint planning

Start from the user's target and available work items. Prioritize by user value,
risk reduction, dependencies, and effort. Keep capacity assumptions explicit;
define a realistic goal, ordered tasks, testable completion criteria, and
deferred work. Do not claim team capacity or create tracker items without
evidence or permission.
